fact: The inaugural steering committee meeting of the IGAD regional digital market integration project, financed by the African Development Bank and covering Djibouti, Ethiopia, Somalia and South Sudan, was held on 28-29 July 2025 in Arta, Djibouti.
title: La Poste de Djibouti se positionne au cœur du futur marché numérique de la Corne de l’Afrique
publisher: Ministère de la Communication chargé des Postes et des Télécommunications (MCPT)
